en:
Like I promised, today is the 
"Cosplay Is Fun" episode.

<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi seems pretty energized.
I wonder what she has in store for me.

Hmm, first...I'll tell you words of 
wisdom from my cosplay friends.
"You make the size of your eyes up!"
...What?

Make up! Makeup's pretty much like 
drawing a picture on your face.

You can make someone look like a 
completely different person with makeup!
I-I see...

With makeup, some guys can crossplay so well,
it makes me feel like I've lost as a woman...
They "crossplay"?

They're so cute, I don't even think twice 
seeing them in the women's restroom!

B-But they shouldn't be in
there in the first place, right?

Cons can get super chaotic. Hot guys coming out
of the women's restroom and vice versa.

<CLT=cltMIND>I can imagine it gets
pretty chaotic...

Oh! And I should show you pictures 
of cosplayers reenacting scenes.

They reenact scenes?
What do you mean?

It's when people cosplaying characters 
from the same work get together...

And they try to reenact famous 
scenes from their work.

But 2D poses aren't the same 
as 3D, of course!

In order to reproduce them, sometimes
you need super weird setups.

Like stepstools, people holding you up, 
or...especially unladylike poses...
<CLT=cltMIND>...I shouldn't ask.
Well, that about covers it...
It must be hard to keep that figure
What's it feel like to draw a crowd?
Being on location must be fun
Are you unsure of something?

But I've been talking the whole time. Is 
there something you want to hear about?
It must be hard to keep that figure.

S-Sexual harassment!? I didn't think 
you were looking at me like that...

N-No, that's not what I mean...
I'm just saying, you put a lot of work in...

Just so you know, I immediately report
any low-angle skirt pictures!
I told you, that's not what I mean!

<CLT=cltMIND>I should probably change
the subject...
What's it feel like to draw a crowd?
Hmm, that's a hard question...

To be honest, it makes me feel like 
a panda at the zoo, I guess...

<CLT=cltMIND>I can see that... Surrounded by
people, everyone taking photos...

*sigh* I'd much rather make 
cosplay than wear them...

<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi seems kind of stressed out,
I should change the subject.
Being on location must be fun.

Yeah, going on location makes you 
feel like you really are that character.

And it's actually pretty fun trying to 
find good locations for photoshoots.

Like when you find a place that's just 
perfect. A sacred place for cosplay!

Oh, but of course, you need to make 
sure it's okay to take pictures there.

Which location was the
most fun for you?

Hmm... Well, wouldn't say fun, but the 
one that left the biggest impression is...

An event at a theme park where I was 
cosplaying a character from a kids' show.

All the kids there kept yelling,
"Do your special move!"

The other cosplayers and I tried to do the 
poses, but the kids didn't like them.

So I ended up practicing them a bunch. 
It turned into a good learning experience.

<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi is having so much fun
explaining all this. I'm having fun too.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Tsumugi's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>I listened to Tsumugi's fond memories of
cosplaying, then returned to my room.
